visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a medium shot of a middle-aged man with short, styled dark hair wearing a dark blue linen shirt. He is seated in a brightly lit, modern medical consultation room with white walls and cabinetry. He gestures with his hands while speaking to someone off-camera, his facial expressions shifting from curiosity to mild apprehension. (2) The scene cuts to the man standing in a lobby area in front of a white wall featuring the logo '博樂醫美'. He is wearing a black jacket and a white surgical mask, waving and pointing towards the sign. The background shows a clean, professional aesthetic environment with balanced studio-style lighting. (3) A sequence shows the man sitting across a desk from a male doctor in a white lab coat and glasses. The doctor uses a pen to point at a document while explaining a procedure. The man nods and touches his own face, specifically his chin and cheeks, as they discuss the treatment plan in a private office setting. (4) The man is then shown lying on a white medical bed. A female clinic staff member in a black uniform and mask is cleaning his face with a white cloth. In a subsequent shot, she uses a brush to apply a thick white topical cream to his forehead and cheeks. The lighting is soft and focused on the treatment area. (5) The man appears with clear plastic wrap covering his face over the white cream. He talks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He wears a black headband with 'ELLANSÉ' branding. The background is a slightly blurred clinic room. (6) A brief close-up shows the man's feet in black socks on the medical bed, twitching slightly as if nervous. The scene then transitions back to the man signing a paper document on a clipboard. (7) Final phase shows the man still with the plastic wrap on his face, laughing and making peace signs with his fingers toward the camera, appearing more relaxed after the initial consultation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog designed to showcase the experience and results of a male client undergoing various medical aesthetic treatments (Thermage, HIFU, fillers) at a specific clinic. It uses a lighthearted, humorous approach to address common fears like pain to make the services seem more accessible to men.
